summary: Tested FishCast Expo/React Native fishing forecast app end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests passed (root, geocode, reverse-geocode, forecast structure, AI species, AI almanac, spots CRUD, catches CRUD). Frontend: empty-state, location modal with geocode search + selection, Today screen with score/verdict/pressure trend/wind/temp/sun&solunar/AI almanac, 7-day Forecast tab with score badges + tap-to-expand, and Log tab empty-state with FAB all render correctly on 390x844 mobile viewport.

issues: Deprecation console warnings: 'shadow*' style props (should migrate to boxShadow) and props.pointerEvents (should move to style.pointerEvents). Cosmetic only, app still renders.

action_items: Optional: silence the React Native Web deprecation warnings for shadow* and pointerEvents by migrating styles.
Optional: Align expo / expo-font / expo-router minor versions per startup warning (cosmetic; app builds & runs).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is single-file ~620 lines; consider splitting into routers/services/models for maintainability (still under 700-line guideline, acceptable for MVP).
MongoDB _id correctly excluded via projection {"_id":0} on list endpoints and uuid 'id' used as PK — verified via assertions.
AI species endpoint has robust JSON cleanup (strips ```json fences, regex-matches [..]) — good defensive parsing.
Reverse geocode falls back to coords label when upstream returns no result — graceful.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical flows verified visually & via body text; Fish tab AI species grid not deep-screenshotted due to image-count limits but navigation tab is present and tappable)

seed_data_creation: Test spots & catches were created and deleted by pytest fixtures (TEST_ prefix). No residual data left.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints verified working end-to-end via the EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. AI endpoints take ~5-15s — keep generous timeouts. Frontend uses testID values: set-location-button, location-search-input. The location modal requires explicit 'Search' button tap (no auto-search on type). Bottom-tabs use text labels: Today, Forecast, Fish, Log — could collide with body text; prefer role=tab selector if needed.
